name: BSP_EntityWorld_FlushActivations
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_world_entities, read-only analysis. __thiscall(this), RET (009036a8), no argument, ECX game+19CCh from BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e5382. Three callers: 004e4a40, BSP_Game_CheckMissionCompletion 004d7ea0 and 0046b730, so it is a flush several sites can force rather than a per-frame-only pass. Walks the intrusive chain from [this+4h] linked through node+38h and calls 00922fd0(node) when node+5Eh is set, node+6Ch is clear, and either node+3Ch is null or node+3Ch->5Eh is clear (00903680-009036a5). 00922fd0 sets +5Eh and +5Dh, clears +5Ch, latches +6Ch, recurses over children from node+48h linked through +44h for children whose +6Ch is clear, and tail-calls virtual +84h, so the outer walk skips any node reached as a child. game+19CCh is the same world object whose +4ACh byte gates BSP_EntityManager_Update 00481640; it is constructed at 004de686 with 004cb030 and initialised with 009037f0(1, 1). Supersedes the BSP_BotManager_Update proposal in docs/GAME_ON_MOVE_MAP.md, which rested on segment keywords alone. docs/GAME_WORLD_ENTITIES.md.

name: BSP_World_UpdateEntities

name: BSP_MissionProgress_IsCompleted
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(table, const NativeString* missionId) returning bool in AL. Calls the lower-bound find 0090C100, which orders with BSP_NativeString_LessCaseInsensitive 00443D00, checks the returned iterator against the container's end node at table+4h, and returns node->value != 0 with the mapped int at node+14h (pair<NativeString,int> at node+0Ch). The table is the 24h-byte object at profile+64h that 007FDB20 recreates with new(24h) + 00920E10. 005C4080 asks it about record+00h for every 434h mission record, so the key is the mission id and a non-zero value means completed. Called by 007FC4C0 with ECX = [game+650h+64h] and by 005C2F70, 005C3BE0, 005C3DE0, 005C4080. See docs/PROFILE_UNLOCK_PREDICATE.md.

name: BSP_LegacySave_MidwayFolderPreexisted
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet award_grant_path, read-only analysis. No arguments, RET (the 004e42ec call site loads ECX from *(*(00E188A8)+21A0h) but the body never reads it). SHGetSpecialFolderPathA(0, buf, 5, 0), concatenates \Battlestations-Midway\save, CreateDirectoryA. Returns 1 only when the create fails with ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS (0B7h); a newly created folder or any other failure returns 0. Gates the GA_HM award at 004e42f7.
